overview_description.description:
Manner is a specialty coffee chain that believes that coffee should be a healthy drink affordable to all people. While insisting on bringing good coffee to every customer, MANNER also takes environmental protection as its own social responsibility. MANNER will reduce 5 yuan for every behavior of bringing non-disposable paper cups to the store to enjoy coffee.

The company is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
